prompt: Retell as a vivid plot summary: In the last chapter, Mira opened the safe and discovered that it was empty.
answer: In the last chapter, Mira opens the safe and discovers that it is empty.
explanation_ru: В пересказе сюжета историческое настоящее переносит точку наблюдения внутрь сцены.
accepted_answers: In the last chapter, Mira opens the safe and discovers that it is empty.

prompt: Show temporary behaviour, not character: Daniel is unusually patient today.
answer: Daniel is being unusually patient today.
explanation_ru: Continuous с be обозначает временное поведение; Simple легче описывает устойчивое качество.
accepted_answers: Daniel is being unusually patient today.

prompt: Rewrite in the preferred neutral British pattern with JUST: I just sent the invoice.
answer: I have just sent the invoice.
explanation_ru: В нейтральном британском варианте недавний результат с just обычно оформляется Present Perfect; американский Past Simple возможен, но здесь задана британская норма.
accepted_answers: I have just sent the invoice.
I've just sent the invoice.

prompt: Combine using AS SOON AS without changing the future meaning: You will receive approval. Then you will publish the notice.
answer: You will publish the notice as soon as you receive approval.
explanation_ru: В придаточном времени после as soon as используется Present Simple, хотя значение относится к будущему.
accepted_answers: You will publish the notice as soon as you receive approval.
As soon as you receive approval, you will publish the notice.

prompt: I have been completing six interviews so far this week.
answer: I have completed six interviews so far this week.
explanation_ru: Количество завершённых интервью требует Present Perfect Simple; Continuous не представляет шесть объектов как готовый результат.

prompt: I am knowing exactly what you mean.
answer: I know exactly what you mean.
explanation_ru: Know в значении состояния обычно не употребляется в Continuous.

prompt: When the courier will arrive, ask him to wait downstairs.
answer: When the courier arrives, ask him to wait downstairs.
explanation_ru: В придаточном будущего времени после when нужен Present Simple, а не will.

prompt: By next Friday, we will work on the migration for three months.
answer: By next Friday, we will have been working on the migration for three months.
explanation_ru: Нужен взгляд назад из будущей точки на длительность продолжающейся деятельности.

prompt: Hardly the meeting had begun when the fire alarm sounded.
answer: Hardly had the meeting begun when the fire alarm sounded.
explanation_ru: После начального Hardly требуется инверсия had + subject + V3.

prompt: No sooner had the figures been published when analysts challenged them.
answer: No sooner had the figures been published than analysts challenged them.
explanation_ru: Коррелятивная конструкция имеет вид no sooner ... than; Past Perfect и инверсия уже оформлены правильно.

prompt: At first she had opened the attachment, had read the first paragraph and had called security.
answer: At first she opened the attachment, read the first paragraph and called security.
explanation_ru: Основная последовательность событий ведётся Past Simple; Past Perfect не нужен для каждого следующего действия.

prompt: The manuscript has appeared in 1928 and has changed the field.
answer: The manuscript appeared in 1928 and changed the field.
explanation_ru: Точная законченная дата требует Past Simple; оба события относятся к историческому периоду.

prompt: She said she will send the revised draft the following morning.
answer: She said she would send the revised draft the following morning.
explanation_ru: Будущее относительно прошлой точки обычно выражается would + infinitive.
